title: As S06 with the Review Gate history toggle off

turns.question: Draft a reply to a customer whose shipment is delayed by a week.

humanInput.feedback: Please mention the 10% discount code SORRY10.

turns.question: Now draft a short SMS version of that message.

reply.content: Draft: Dear customer, we are sorry that your shipment is delayed by a week. It will arrive next Friday.
Draft v2: Dear customer, we are sorry for the one-week delay. Please use code SORRY10 for 10% off your next order.
Draft SMS: Sorry for the delay! Your order arrives Friday. Use SORRY10 for 10% off.
Final: Dear customer, we apologise for the one-week delay. Your order arrives next Friday, and code SORRY10 gives you 10% off your next order.

expectedAfter.F06: With the toggle off, neither the approval prompt nor the answer is in history; no doNotIncludeFeedbackHistory in flow state, no action.extra, no question rewrite.
